chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad al-Qummī narrated from al-Riḍā عليه السلام that he said:

"Whoever visits the grave of my father عليه السلام in Baghdad is like one who has visited the grave of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the grave of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, except that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام have their superiority."

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; referring to the father of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام
key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.قَبْرَ: grave; the burial place being visited

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of visiting the grave of Imam al-Kāẓim عليه السلام in Baghdad?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the great merit of visiting the grave of the father of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام in Baghdad. It likens that visitation to visiting the graves of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, while affirming the unique superiority of those two.
